changelog:
v4.1.0 — Smoother Navigation + MultiView Upgrade

• The highlight cursor now always returns to the item you were on when backing out of playback or a detail page — on Home, Movies, Series, Favorites, Live TV, and the TV Guide.
• Home: the hero buttons now show a clear white highlight, and Right/Left moves between Play and More Info (edges still flip through featured titles).
• MultiView: channels load with their logo while connecting, audio switching flashes the active screen, labels are easier to read from the couch, playback now pauses when you leave the app (battery/heat), exiting is a quick double-press of Back, and auto-fill now picks channels from the same category as your starting channel.
• MultiView streams that error now recover through the proper ladder instead of flickering.
